World Clock

See live clocks for eight major world cities, plus any time zone you add yourself. Every clock updates each second, with your local date shown too.

Clocks update every second and handle daylight saving automatically.

📖 How to use

  1. Scroll to see the live clocks for the eight default cities.
  2. Type a time zone name (e.g. America/Chicago) in the "Add your own" box.
  3. Click "Add" to pin a new live clock for that zone.
  4. Use the delete button on a custom clock to remove it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Do the clocks handle daylight saving time?

The clocks use your browser's built-in time zone database (Intl.DateTimeFormat), so they handle daylight saving automatically and always reflect the current date.

Which time zones can I add?

Type an IANA time zone name such as America/Chicago or Asia/Karachi. If the name is not recognized, you will see a friendly error and nothing is added.

Are my added cities remembered?

Yes — any custom time zones you add are saved in your browser, so they are still there the next time you open the tool on this device.
